Summary.title: Professional Summary
Summary.headline: Exploring web and cloud-native apps development.
Summary.subtext: I am a Computer Engineering graduate with hands-on experience in full-stack development, cloud-native applications, and technical support. I have worked with Golang, React, and Google Cloud, and have solid understanding of Agile practices, CI/CD, and software design. I am currently focused on improving my skills in web development and cloud-native application development. I am actively seeking for entry-level or junior software development roles where I can contribute, learn, and continue to grow as a developer.
